label: Naming
summary: Procedure, class, variable, constant, and parameter naming conventions.
must_follow: Use documented prefixes: s, n, b, d, a, o, fn, and v.
avoid: Do not rename values in behavior-preserving refactors unless the refactor scope includes naming cleanup.
Do not invent prefixes outside the documented set without a reason.

elements.name: DECLARE
elements.summary: Declares one or more variables in the current SSL scope.

elements.name: PARAMETERS
elements.summary: Declares named input parameters for a script, procedure, method, or constructor.

elements.name: PUBLIC
elements.summary: Declares global variables that can be accessed from any scope in the program.
